response.sql: WITH fee_base AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge AS side, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009), group_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, side, AVG(net_rate) AS group_avg_net, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fee_base GROUP BY orderslink, side), side_stats AS (SELECT side, AVG(group_avg_net) AS side_avg FROM group_stats GROUP BY side) SELECT g.orderslink, g.side, g.group_avg_net, g.record_count, g.group_avg_net - s.side_avg AS diff_from_side_avg FROM group_stats g JOIN side_stats s ON g.side IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.side WHERE g.group_avg_net > s.side_avg ORDER BY diff_from_side_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
